caption: A desk lamp is moved from the left side of a vase to the right side, and the vase's shadow swings from the right side of the vase to the left.

sa.check: A desk lamp stands to the left of a vase.
The lamp is moved to the right side of the vase.
The shadow swings from the right of the vase to the left.
The lamp moves first and the shadow follows.

pc.expect: The shadow always falls on the side of the vase opposite the lamp and moves smoothly as the lamp moves.
pc.fail: The shadow stays put while the lamp moves; or it moves with the lamp to the same side; or it jumps from one side to the other.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the vase's outline, stretching or shortening with the angle.
pc.fail: It becomes a different shape; or splits into two under one lamp; or keeps a fixed shape while the lamp plainly moves.

pc.expect: The shadow moves only while the lamp moves.
pc.fail: It moves with the lamp still; or it keeps moving after the lamp has stopped; or it moves before the lamp.

pc.expect: The shadow starts at the vase's base and lies on the table.
pc.fail: It floats detached from the base; or it appears on the ceiling; or it is missing with the lamp plainly on.

pc.expect: One lamp, one vase and one shadow; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the table.
pc.fail: A second vase or shadow appears; or the vase vanishes; or the lamp passes through the vase; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The vase, the lamp and the table stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The vase changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the table pattern shifts.
